create_wecom_callback_adapter: create a WecomCallbackAdapter instance configured with platform config for WeCom callback integration
build_wecom_callback_server: build an aiohttp server that listens for encrypted WeCom XML callbacks on a configurable host, port, and path
test_wecom_callback_requirements: test whether aiohttp and httpx dependencies are available for the WeCom callback adapter
send_wecom_message: send a proactive text message to a WeCom user via the message/send API using an access token
refresh_wecom_access_token: refresh a WeCom access token for a configured app using the gettoken API with corp_id and corp_secret
